source_scope.source_detail_limit: Push DDL exposes only an unversioned message JSON envelope while examples imply fourteen fields. Collect DDL has trailing commas, ambiguous money units and no deletion/outcome dictionaries.

verification_policy.specified_definition: Each source has same-name DDL evidence plus explicit Principal/Catalog/Promotion/Notification/Favorite authority, JSON or money correction, lifecycle, security and runtime gate.
verification_policy.verified_definition: Verification requires non-empty production full-denominator reconciliation with versioned payload schema, qualified identity mappings and delivery/favorite/reminder lifecycle conservation.

lifecycle_policy_defaults.history_policy: Notification intent, delivery attempt/receipt and favorite/reminder behavior append; mutable current projections derive from immutable observations.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.delete_policy: Unfavorite, reminder cancellation and content suppression append explicit lifecycle facts; source deletion never erases delivery or consent audit.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.backfill_policy: Resolve tenant, Principal, Catalog SPU/SKU, Promotion entitlement/campaign and payload schema before replay; quarantine ambiguous money, result codes, channels, consent or orphan references.

semantic_rules.authority: Engagement owns delivery; Promotion owns entitlement; provider owns external result observation; Consent owns channel permission

corrections: require a versioned JSON schema because the DDL declares only message STRING
correct misspelled createtor fields at the mapping boundary
map push_result_code through a provider-and-version-specific dictionary

assets.source_grain: one source favorite behavior observation per favorite id

semantic_rules.grain: one immutable favorite/unfavorite behavior; current Favorite is a projection per Principal and Catalog target
semantic_rules.identity: source user/SPU/SKU map to Principal and canonical Catalog identities; SKU/SPU are not equated
semantic_rules.money_or_quantity: price is a source-time observation requiring ISO currency and minor-unit proof, never Listing price authority
semantic_rules.history: behavior appends and current favorite derives from latest valid version; modify_time cannot overwrite history
semantic_rules.security: Principal is a reference; no profile, device or content PII enters the event
semantic_rules.authority: Engagement owns preference behavior; Catalog owns SPU/SKU; Listing owns sellable price

corrections: require explicit favorite/unfavorite action because the DDL lacks lifecycle semantics
quarantine price until currency and unit are proven
reject SKU/SPU ids without qualified canonical mappings
